<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Snake Game</title>
    <style>
        body {
            background-color: #2f2f2f;
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
        }
        canvas {
            border: 1px solid #ffffff;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <canvas id="game-canvas" width="400" height="400"></canvas>
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('game-canvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        let snake = [
            {x: 200, y: 200},
            {x: 190, y: 200},
            {x: 180, y: 200}
        ];
        let direction = 'right';
        let score = 0;
        let food = {x: Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) * 10, y: Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) * 10};
        function draw() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            for (let i = 0; i < snake.length; i++) {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.5)';
                ctx.fillRect(snake[i].x, snake[i].y, 10, 10);
            }
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5)';
            ctx.fillRect(food.x, food.y, 10, 10);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)';
            ctx.font = '24px Inter';
            ctx.textAlign = 'left';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
            ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 10);
        }
        function update() {
            for (let i = snake.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                snake[i] = { ...snake[i - 1] };
            }
            if (direction === 'right') {
                snake[0].x += 10;
            } else if (direction === 'left') {
                snake[0].x -= 10;
            } else if (direction === 'up') {
                snake[0].y -= 10;
            } else if (direction === 'down') {
                snake[0].y += 10;
            }
            if (snake[0].x === food.x && snake[0].y === food.y) {
                score++;
                food = {x: Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) * 10, y: Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) * 10};
                snake.push({x: snake[snake.length - 1].x, y: snake[snake.length - 1].y});
            }
            for (let i = 1; i < snake.length; i++) {
                if (snake[0].x === snake[i].x && snake[0].y === snake[i].y) {
                    alert('Game Over!');
                    snake = [
                        {x: 200, y: 200},
                        {x: 190, y: 200},
                        {x: 180, y: 200}
                    ];
                    direction = 'right';
                    score = 0;
                }
            }
            if (snake[0].x < 0 || snake[0].x >= canvas.width || snake[0].y < 0 || snake[0].y >= canvas.height) {
                alert('Game Over!');
                snake = [
                    {x: 200, y: 200},
                    {x: 190, y: 200},
                    {x: 180, y: 200}
                ];
                direction = 'right';
                score = 0;
            }
        }
        function handleKey(event) {
            if (event.key === 'ArrowRight' || event.key === 'd') {
                if (direction !== 'left') {
                    direction = 'right';
                }
            } else if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' || event.key === 'a') {
                if (direction !== 'right') {
                    direction = 'left';
                }
            } else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp' || event.key === 'w') {
                if (direction !== 'down') {
                    direction = 'up';
                }
            } else if (event.key === 'ArrowDown' || event.key === 's') {
                if (direction !== 'up') {
                    direction = 'down';
                }
            }
        }
        document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
        setInterval(() => {
            update();
            draw();
        }, 100);
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Racing Game</title>
    <style>
        body {
            background-color: #2f2f2f;
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
        }
        canvas {
            border: 1px solid #ffffff;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <canvas id="game-canvas" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('game-canvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        let player = {x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height - 50, speed: 5};
        let obstacles = [];
        let score = 0;
        let speedBoosters = [];
        let distance = 0;
        let engineSound = new AudioContext();
        let engineOscillator = engineSound.createOscillator();
        engineOscillator.type = 'sawtooth';
        engineOscillator.frequency.value = 100;
        engineOscillator.connect(engineSound.destination);
        engineOscillator.start();
        function draw() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.5)';
            ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, 50, 50);
            for (let i = 0; i < obstacles.length; i++) {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5)';
                ctx.fillRect(obstacles[i].x, obstacles[i].y, 50, 50);
            }
            for (let i = 0; i < speedBoosters.length; i++) {
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 255, 0.5)';
                ctx.fillRect(speedBoosters[i].x, speedBoosters[i].y, 50, 50);
            }
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)';
            ctx.font = '24px Inter';
            ctx.textAlign = 'left';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
            ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 10);
            ctx.fillText(`Distance: ${distance}m`, 10, 40);
        }
        function update() {
            player.x += player.speed;
            if (player.x + 50 > canvas.width || player.x < 0) {
                player.speed = -player.speed;
            }
            for (let i = 0; i < obstacles.length; i++) {
                obstacles[i].y += 5;
                if (obstacles[i].y > canvas.height) {
                    obstacles.splice(i, 1);
                }
                if (checkCollision(player, obstacles[i])) {
                    alert('Game Over!');
                    player = {x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height - 50, speed: 5};
                    obstacles = [];
                    score = 0;
                    distance = 0;
                }
            }
            for (let i = 0; i < speedBoosters.length; i++) {
                speedBoosters[i].y += 5;
                if (speedBoosters[i].y > canvas.height) {
                    speedBoosters.splice(i, 1);
                }
                if (checkCollision(player, speedBoosters[i])) {
                    player.speed *= 1.5;
                    speedBoosters.splice(i, 1);
                }
            }
            if (Math.random() < 0.05) {
                obstacles.push({x: Math.floor(Math.random() * (canvas.width - 50)), y: 0});
            }
            if (Math.random() < 0.01) {
                speedBoosters.push({x: Math.floor(Math.random() * (canvas.width - 50)), y: 0});
            }
            distance += 5;
            score += 1;
        }
        function checkCollision(obj1, obj2) {
            if (obj1.x + 50 > obj2.x && obj1.x < obj2.x + 50 && obj1.y + 50 > obj2.y && obj1.y < obj2.y + 50) {
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        function handleKey(event) {
            if (event.key === 'ArrowRight' || event.key === 'd') {
                player.speed = 5;
            } else if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' || event.key === 'a') {
                player.speed = -5;
            }
        }
        document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKey);
        setInterval(() => {
            update();
            draw();
        }, 16);
    </script>
</body>
</html>

review_result.summary: The provided code for the Snake and Racing games is functional but has several areas that need improvement for better performance, security, and maintainability.

issues.description: The game logic is tightly coupled with the rendering code. Consider separating the game logic into its own module or file for better maintainability.
issues.suggestion: Create a separate JavaScript file for the game logic and import it into the HTML file.

issues.description: The game does not handle cases where the snake runs into the edge of the canvas. This can cause the game to crash or behave unexpectedly.
issues.suggestion: Add boundary checking to prevent the snake from moving outside the canvas.

issues.description: The game uses a fixed interval for updating and drawing the game state. Consider using a more dynamic approach, such as using requestAnimationFrame, for better performance.
issues.suggestion: Replace setInterval with requestAnimationFrame for smoother animation.

issues.description: The game does not handle cases where the player collides with multiple obstacles or speed boosters at the same time. This can cause the game to crash or behave unexpectedly.
issues.suggestion: Add collision detection to handle multiple obstacles and speed boosters.

issues.description: The game uses the AudioContext API without proper error handling. This can cause security vulnerabilities if not handled properly.
issues.suggestion: Add proper error handling for the AudioContext API to prevent security vulnerabilities.
